title: Immunocytochemistry and Confocal Imaging of iNeurons
author: Felix Kraus
materials: Incubate cells with secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
Cells are now ready for imaging.
Camera: Hamamatsu ORCA-Fusion BT CMOS (16-bit acquisition).
Segmentation masks are filtered by area (100–10,000 pixels).

steps.title: Pre-warm fixative
steps.instruction: Place 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS in a 37 °C water bath until warmed.

steps.title: Prepare antibody dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute primary and secondary antibodies in 3% BSA‑PBS to the recommended concentrations.

steps.title: Calibrate microscope and lasers
steps.instruction: Verify that the confocal microscope and all laser lines are correctly calibrated before imaging.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Aspirate culture medium from differentiated iNeurons, add pre‑warmed 4% PFA in PBS, and incubate for 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Permeabilize and rinse cells
steps.instruction: Remove PFA, rinse cells once with PBS, then incubate in 0.5% Triton X‑100 in PBS for 15 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 0.5% Triton X‑100 in PBS for 15 min at RT

steps.title: Wash cells with PBST
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST (0.02 % Tween‑20 in PBS).

steps.title: Block with BSA
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 3% BSA in PBS for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash post-block PBST
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST.

steps.title: Incubate with antibody solution
steps.instruction: Add the prepared antibody solution to the cells and incubate for 3 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Add Hoechst 33342 diluted 1:10,000 in PBST, incubate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final PBST washes
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBST.

steps.title: Acquire confocal images
steps.instruction: Acquire images at room temperature using a Yokogawa CSU‑W1 spinning‑disk confocal system mounted on a Nikon Eclipse Ti2‑E microscope; apply lasers sequentially with a Nikon LUN‑F XL laser combiner.

steps.title: Analyze calcium imaging data
steps.instruction: Analyze time‑lapse calcium imaging datasets with the custom Python pipeline.

steps.title: Read ND2 image stacks
steps.instruction: Read ND2 image stacks using the nd2 Python package.

steps.title: Segment neuronal somas
steps.instruction: Segment neuronal somas with CellposeSAM using the pretrained neuronal‑soma model.

steps.title: Quantify synaptic puncta
steps.instruction: Quantify synaptic puncta of Synaptophysin (SYP) and Bassoon (BSN) using the custom Python pipeline.

steps.title: Perform colocalization analysis
steps.instruction: Perform object‑level colocalization analysis between SYP and Bassoon puncta.

steps.title: Statistical analysis in R
steps.instruction: Conduct downstream statistical analysis and visualization in R.

steps.title: Perform gentle buffer exchanges
steps.instruction: Perform gentle buffer exchanges as needed.
